# Product query dependency scope

The Product query can name a public entry supplied through a Product dependency.
The paired [Build-only control](../../../fail/build/product_entry_query_build_scope_alias/build.omg)
rejects that same path: a Build-purpose edge supplies no Product lookup scope.
Neither witness directly imports an unexecuted Build dependency. Explicit
provider readiness retired that host-library route.

The positive binds all four hosted targets and executes natively and in Terminal.
